channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about John Paxson | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about John Paxson from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Shaquille O'Neal on John Paxson, Kyrie Irving, Jamal Murray
item.description:
Shaquille O'Neal:

“I get annoyed when people cherry-pick moments in a player's career. Who took the winning shot in Game 7 in 2016? Kyrie Irving. Who hit the game-winner in 1993? John Paxson. Who hit the game-winner last night for Denver? Jamal Murray. That's the sport of basketball—sometimes it's your time, sometimes it's your teammates'.”

Shaquille O'Neal on John Paxson, Kyrie Irving, Jamal Murray, May 6, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Arturas Karnisovas on John Paxson
item.description:
Arturas on using Paxson:

“I think right from the start during this hiring process, they were hiring No. 1 decision maker. John has a great reputation around the league and can be an asset. I appreciate his candor. he could be a huge help while I'm making this transition.”

Arturas Karnisovas on John Paxson, Apr 13, 2020. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: Jim Boylen on John Paxson
item.description:
“I've said this before, we've just got to get this right. That's my goal. It's not about me being the head coach. We've got to get it right for the city, we've got to get it right for the Reinsdorfs, we've got to get it right for John Paxson.”

Jim Boylen on John Paxson, Oct 1, 2019. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Phil Jackson, John Paxson
item.description:
Here’s the MJ story Kerr told Durant:

“When MJ was with the Bulls, they had a playoff game. He kept trying to score and he was scoring, but they weren’t getting anything going. Phil Jackson said, ‘Who’s open?’ He said, ‘John Paxson.’I want you to trust your teammates early. What you’re doing is you’re getting to the rim and then you’re trying to hit them. I want you to trust the first guy and then move. Still attack, still look to score, but trust these guys, OK?”

Steve Kerr on Phil Jackson, John Paxson, Jun 2, 2018. Source: For The Win.

item.title: Jerry Reinsdorf on John Paxson
item.description:
Reinsdorf said Tuesday in a phone interview.

“He’s a fine evaluator of talent. He’s a long-term thinker. He works well with the general manager. He works well with coaches. I’m a John Paxson fan.”

Jerry Reinsdorf on John Paxson, Dec 19, 2017. Source: Chicago Tribune.

item.title: Jerry Reinsdorf on John Paxson, Jerry Krause
item.description:
“I picked John Paxson to rebuild when (Jerry) Krause left (in 2003) because he’s a leader. Nothing has changed,”

Jerry Reinsdorf on John Paxson, Jerry Krause, Dec 19, 2017. Source: Chicago Tribune.

item.title: Taj Gibson on John Paxson, Gar Forman
item.description:
“I talk with Gar and Pax (Gar Forman and John Paxson) almost every other day, so I never get that feeling (of being shopped), but you never know,”

Taj Gibson on John Paxson, Gar Forman, Feb 18, 2016. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on John Paxson
item.description:
“(Executive vice president John Paxson) and Gar are in charge of putting the roster together. I have a voice. They make the final decision. That's the way it works.”

Tom Thibodeau on John Paxson, Jul 14, 2013. Source: Chicago Tribune.
